questions.question: How much traffic for a 12port gigabit switch capable of generating when operating at full wire speed?
questions.answer: 12 Gb/s, by providing full bandwidth to each port
choices: a. 24 Gb/s, because this is the maximum forwarding rate on Cisco switches
b. 26 Gb/s, because of overhead requirements
c. 1 Gb/s, because data can only be forwarded from one port at a time
d. 12 Gb/s, by providing full bandwidth to each port

questions.question: How much traffic for a 24port Gbit switch at hand capable of generating when operating at full wire speed?
choices: a. 12 Gb/s, because of overhead requirements
b. 24 Gb/s, by providing full bandwidth to each port
c. 48 Gb/s, because this is the maximum forwarding rate on Cisco switches
d. 48 Gb/s, because of overhead requirements

questions.question: In managing Cisco devices, what are two ways to access a Cisco switch for out-of-band management?

questions.question: In managing Cisco devices, what is a characteristic of out-of-band device management?
questions.answer: It requires a terminal emulation client.

b. It requires at least one network interface on the device to be connected and operational.
c. It requires a terminal emulation client.
d. Out-of-band device management requires a direct connection to a network interface.

questions.question: In this chapter, what is the function of PoE pass-through?
questions.answer: Allows switches, phones, and wireless access points to receive power over existing Ethernet cables from an upstream switch
choices: a. Allows a multilayer switch to forward IP packets at a rate close to that of Layer 2 switching by bypassing the CPU
b. Allows multiple physical switch ports to be aggregated together and act as a single logical link to increase bandwidth on trunk links
c. Allows switches, phones, and wireless access points to receive power over existing Ethernet cables from an upstream switch
d. Allows a switch to disable redundant Layer 2 paths in the topology to prevent Layer 2 loops

questions.question: In today's current switch technology, Which statement describes a characteristic of Cisco Meraki switches?

b. They are campus LAN switches that perform the same functions as Cisco 2960 switches.
c. They are service provider switches that aggregate traffic at the edge of the network.
d. They are cloud-managed access switches that enable virtual stacking of switches.
